import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                          hue='BMI Category', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
ax2.bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', alpha=0.8)

ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.legend(fontsize=9)

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Disorders by BMI Category
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
disorder_bmi = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None'), normalize='index') * 100
disorder_bmi.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, width=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1))
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Variables', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Gender
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
scatter2 = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level', 
                           hue='Gender', style='Gender', s=70, alpha=0.7, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)

# 6. Age Distribution with Sleep Quality
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
age_bins = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65])
age_sleep = df.groupby(age_bins)['Quality of Sleep'].mean()
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(age_sleep)), age_sleep.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(age_sleep)))
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Sleep Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(age_sleep)))
ax6.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in age_sleep.index], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.05,
             f'{height:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
